# Haggai

::: {.book-summary}
## Book Summary Insight

Haggai encourages the returned exiles to rebuild the Temple and prioritize God's work. The book teaches that spiritual priorities bring lasting blessing.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 1

<div class="key-verse">Haggai 1:5</div>

<div class="identifier">Consider your ways</div>

### Why This Verse

Central challenge of the book

### Chapter Insight

This chapter calls the returned exiles to prioritize rebuilding God's Temple. The key verse challenges God's people to examine their priorities and place God's work above personal comfort and prosperity.
:::

::: {.chapter-entry}
## Chapter 2

<div class="key-verse">Haggai 2:9</div>

<div class="identifier">The glory of this latter house shall be greater</div>

### Why This Verse

Famous temple promise

### Chapter Insight

This chapter encourages the people with promises of God's presence, future glory, and coming blessing. The key verse points to a future fulfillment in which God's glory will surpass anything seen before and His kingdom purposes will prevail.
:::
